# authwise_tenant_config (Resource)

The config of an existing tenant: its brand, and its token lifetimes and CORS. The tenant itself is not created or deleted here: tenants are provisioned with awtenant.

`config` is authoritative: the tenant's config becomes exactly this, and a field left out is cleared. Creating the resource replaces whatever config the tenant had. Destroying it clears the config (and `labels`, when set) rather than only dropping it from state, so the assets the brand names can be deleted after it. Reference the logo as `authwise_asset_content.x.asset_id`, not `authwise_asset.x.asset_id`: kit refuses deleting an asset, or removing its content, while the brand names it, and the reference makes Terraform destroy this resource before both.

Writing a tenant needs `tenancy.tenants.update` at the tenant, which a service account holds through `tenant.admin`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authwise_asset" "logo" {
  display_name = "Logo"
  path         = "/logo.png"
  mime_type    = "image/png"
}

resource "authwise_asset_content" "logo" {
  asset_id = authwise_asset.logo.asset_id
  source   = "${path.module}/logo.png"
}

# The logo is named through its content, so a destroy clears the brand
# before kit is asked to remove the content and the asset.
data "authwise_tenant_config" "this" {
  branding = {
    logo_asset_id = authwise_asset_content.logo.asset_id
  }
}

resource "authwise_tenant_config" "this" {
  config = data.authwise_tenant_config.this.json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) The TenantConfig as protojson: `data.authwise_tenant_config.x.json`, or `jsonencode`. kit refuses a `branding` that names no image asset of the tenant, or a dark logo without a light one.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) The tenant's labels. Set, they are authoritative, and destroy clears them. Unset, Terraform leaves the tenant's labels alone.
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant; overrides the provider default. Changing it moves the config: the old tenant's is cleared and the new one's written.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The tenant's full resource name (`tenants/{t}`); serves as the Terraform ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the tenant's id or its full resource name. labels is read back
# only when the tenant has any.
terraform import authwise_tenant_config.this t-01
```
